Name: Dabi my Beloved
Author: Vargamour
Description:
[center][color=#00ffff]"A mysterious adventurer is hunting monsters around the Valley. Rude and unapproachable, he wants nothing to do with the residents of Pelican Town, but that might change when the new farmer arrives..."[/color]

Weaving Touya's story into Stardew canon, the events and dialogue choices will allow you to set the tone of your relationship, while learning more about Touya and his intentions while living in the valley.The end goal is to create a visual novel-like experience with multiple "endings" without impacting the flow of regular gameplay. Other features include giving the player more of a voice and personality, and make the dating and marriage parts of the relationship more rewarding and engaging.[color=#efefef][/color][/center][color=#efefef]
[/color][color=#efefef]
[/color][center][size=4][color=#00ffff]Disclaimer!!![/color][/size]
[color=#efefef]This is my first ever mod, and it is so far from finished, but I wanted to get it out there to get the dialogue and stuff tested. I don't have a lot of free time at the moment to test it all myself, so please, throw as much feedback as you like at me.
[/color][/center][color=#efefef]

[/color][center][size=4][color=#00ffff]He is not completely compatible with 1.6!! [/color]
[/size]I just want to make that disclaimer. I haven't played through the new content yet, so he's not in any of the new festivals or anything like that.
I also haven't tested his full schedule with the update. So far it seems okay, but there might be issues


[size=4][color=#00ffff]The portrait is kinda janky!! Hit the P key (or whatever you have set up for portraiture) til you get it resized. [/color][/size]
This is just a temporary fix til I figure something else out (maybe once HD portraits updates for 1.6 I'll use that instead)[/center]
[size=4][color=#00ffff][center]﻿[/center][center]Dabi's Schedule[/center][/color][/size][center]In my forgetfulness, I might have skimmed over the fact that Dabi is not always in town. I have changed his schedule a bit with the new update, so if you're not sure where to find him, you can check here:


[spoiler][color=#00ffff]Monday:[/color] Bus Stop, Beach (once the sewer is opened, he'll start going down there in the mornings, stinky bastard)
[color=#00ffff]Tuesday:[/color] Ginger island! hangs around the volcano in the morning and dips into one of the caves in the afternoon
[color=#00ffff]Wednesday:[/color] Mountain and Mine (and later on, the railroad)
[color=#00ffff]Thursday:[/color] He's busy. Probably setting something on fire
[color=#00ffff]Friday:[/color] Bus stop, Forest, Saloon
[color=#00ffff]Saturday:[/color] Guild and Beach (He moves to another part of the beach once you fix the bridge
[color=#00ffff]Sunday:[/color] Forest in the morning, and then to the desert in the evening. Don't worry if you don't find him right away. He's not doing anything special lol[/spoiler] [/center]
